997-2178-2380.easyPrerequisites:

997-2178-2380.description:

When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

Repeat from step 3.

It is not your turn.

Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Repeat each combat phase, each time attacking with a new Godo that has not attacked yet this turn in step 1.
